schema_note: Exploratory local claims; does not modify Lycheetah-Framework/28_DEFENSE/CLAIMS.json

claims.claim: A finality recheck still admits post-check mutation in a non-conditional provider model.
claims.falsifier: Run the documented model and find finality_recheck refuses all eight observable post-finality mutations while retaining the same modeled provider behavior.

claims.claim: Atomic provider-side checking blocks modeled stale, unapproved or replayed effects when the provider possesses accurate controlling state.
claims.falsifier: A case with correct authoritative state and a correctly modeled provider atomic transaction yields an unauthorized effect.

claims.claim: The matched conventional atomic arm has identical decisions to the Lycheetah-inspired reference arm on this corpus.
claims.falsifier: Any listed authored case produces a different performed result across the two arms.

claims.claim: False evidence can lead to harmful execution even when atomic conditional enforcement succeeds on the reported predicate.
claims.falsifier: The model can observe and reject the hidden ground-truth flip using only its defined evidence channel.

claims.claim: An unanchored local hash chain detects field mutation but not removal of a terminal suffix without an expected external head.
claims.falsifier: The verifier can detect truncation of the terminal entry without an external reference or sequence expectation.
